title: 第25章 降临
content_zh:
新县令人生地不熟还声名狼藉，本地世家吝啬贪财，县衙官吏更是利益相关。

    凭借着这信息差，魏乐府很快就达成了他想要见到的局面，期间还夹杂着被引导的民怨。

    这导致了新县令的清丈田亩、均平赋役之事进展顺利，只是到处都怨声载道。

    快的原因也很简单，首先是本地世家成了现成的政绩，再加上县衙官吏按照魏乐府的吩咐办事。

    县衙官吏那是把过犹不及展现的淋漓尽致。

    至于真让对方完成了怎么办？那等人送走了再朝令夕改不就行了，民怨不就留着这么用的。

    魏乐府还能顺势接纳李崇昭留下来的各种资料数据。

    以目前的进度，本来是需要一年，但现在三个月就可以了。

    所以他已经开始给李崇昭活动关系了，到时候政绩一够就送他升迁。

    最好是送到京城里去当个有名无实的闲职，来个明升暗降。

    这个其实不难，毕竟京城里一个萝卜一个坑，有实权有油水的难找。

    这种坐冷板凳的可多了去了。

    唯一的麻烦就是太子。

    不过还是那句话，他只管开团，自然会有跟太子不对付的人跟团。

    至于说是否会波及到他这里，也是有可能的，像这次就是无妄之灾。

    只是大多数时候都是天高皇帝远，他人不在京城，自然是鞭长莫及了。

    不过对于魏乐府来说，现在没有心思去处理这些勾心斗角的事情。

    因为降临任务要开启了。

    -----------------

    【新代行者资格考核完毕，所有世界代行者请准备在一个时辰后执行降临任务】

    -----------------

    在魏乐府看来，这一段提示意味着世界恢复一些后，已经有余力再增加新的代行者了。

    人一多，世界恢复会更快，但也有可能会拉低任务完成率导致道种点下降。

    当然，如果道种点的获取跟着人数提升，那么比例就算降低也比之前多的话，那魏乐府也无所谓。

    正想着，周围的一切开始凝固，魏乐府睁开眼时，人就已经穿越了。

    他环顾了一下四周，自己依旧是‘丁守成’，所处位置也是在启程前夕。
content_en:
The new county is unfamiliar to people and has a bad reputation. The local aristocratic families are stingy and greedy for money, and the county government officials have even more interests.

    Relying on this information gap, Wei Yuefu quickly achieved the situation he wanted to see, and the process was also mixed with the public resentment that was directed.

    This resulted in the new county magistrate's efforts to clear land and equalize taxes and levies to go smoothly, but there were complaints everywhere.

    The reason for the speed is also very simple. First of all, the local aristocratic family has become a ready-made political achievement, and in addition, the county government officials act according to the instructions of Wei Yuefu.

    The county government officials vividly displayed their excesses and shortcomings.

    As for what to do if the other party actually completes it? It's okay to send them away and change it morning and evening. Isn't this how people's grievances should be kept?

    Wei Yuefu can also take advantage of the opportunity to accept various materials and data left by Li Chongzhao.

    With the current progress, it was supposed to take a year, but now it only takes three months.

    So he had already started to establish connections with Li Chongzhao, and he would be promoted as soon as his political performance was sufficient.

    It would be best to be sent to the capital to work as a sinecure in name only, rising and falling secretly.

    This is actually not difficult. After all, there are many carrots and pits in the capital, and it is difficult to find someone with real power and money.

    There are too many people sitting on the bench like this.

    The only trouble is the prince.

    But again, if he just starts a group, there will naturally be people who can't deal with the prince.

    As for whether it will affect him, it is also possible. Like this time, it is an unforeseen disaster.

    It's just that most of the time, the sky is high and the emperor is far away. If others are not in the capital, they are naturally out of reach.

    But for Wei Yuefu, he has no time to deal with these intrigues now.

    Because the advent mission is about to start.

    ------------------

    [The qualification assessment for new agents is completed, all world agents please prepare to carry out the advent mission in an hour]

    ------------------

    From Wei Yuefu's point of view, this reminder means that after the world recovers to some extent, it will have enough energy to add new agents.

    With more people, the world will recover faster, but it may also lower the task completion rate and lead to a decrease in Taoist points.

    Of course, if the acquisition of Tao Seed Points increases with the number of people, then even if the proportion decreases, it is still more than before, then Wei Yuefu will not care.

    Just as he was thinking about it, everything around him began to solidify. When Wei Yuefu opened his eyes, he had already traveled through time.

    He looked around and saw that he was still 'Ding Shoucheng', and his position was also on the eve of departure.
